body:
I was prescribed Clonidine in mid-March of '06 for herion withdrawal. I was using herion from October '05 to May '06. Some things I noticed most about the pills were that they lowered my blood presure to sedate me and make me more comfortable for going through withdrawals. As far as saying if it helped or not with the withdrawals, maybe a little bit. Clonidine does not compare to Suboxone/Subutex/Bupenorphine as far as helping with withdrawals.
